disagreements.positions: Round-1 supervisor corrected agent_5's 5.29% to ~5.0% (CNBC, Sep 16). In round 2, agents 3, 4 and 5 use 5.29% on Sep 30 (FRED) and trim multiples to 30.5-31.5x. Agent_1 uses 5.01% (WACC 8.75%). Agent_2 holds 32x.
disagreements.resolution: Agents 3-5 are right and the round-1 supervisor's figure was stale. FRED DGS10 was 5.01% on 2026-09-16 and 5.29% on 2026-09-30, up from 4.79% on Sep 1. This does not move the ladder, because the $401.24 spot already prices it. It does argue against agent_2's 32x and supports the 30.5-31.5x cluster.

disagreements.topic: EUP 2.0 size and scope (1-3% I&A/procedure drag in 2027)
disagreements.positions: All five agents now carry a 1-3% range with a ~2% midpoint (EPS hit ~1.3-2%). Agent_1 adds a primary FY2019-21 10-K check: net I&A/procedure about -1% over 2019-21. Agent_4 says stapling, energy and force-feedback instruments are excluded.
disagreements.resolution: Converged, and the scope claim is corroborated: a second secondary report describes the program as a subset of instruments for high-volume benign procedures, phased in across 2027, with stapling, energy and force-feedback instruments excluded. That supports a drag below the 2020 program's ~6.6% modeled size. The sizing is still unknown until the 2026-10-20 call, so it stays a two-sided binary rather than a reason to shift the centre.
disagreements.evidence: Investing.com company-news recap (cited by agent_4); Rallies.ai recap; Wells Fargo conference recap 2026-09-09; Intuitive FY2021 10-K.

disagreements.positions: Agent_3 lowered its break to $290, arguing that a rates-only de-rating to ~25x (~$300) is possible without fundamental damage. Agents 1, 2, 4 and 5 hold $300.
disagreements.resolution: Keep $300. On ~$13.4 2028E EPS, $300 is ~22.4x, below the 10-year GAAP P/E floor agent_5 cites and well below a 'rates-only' 25-26x. A close there more likely signals fundamental damage. The 5.29% 10-year is the only new input, and it is already in the 30.5-31.5x multiples.
disagreements.evidence: FRED DGS10; agent consensus EPS ($12.09 FY27, single aggregator original).

disagreements.positions: agent_3 $396 (30.5x, -$5 litigation); agent_5 $400; agent_1 $401 (DCF-weighted); agent_4 $409; agent_2 $425 (32x, sees rivals sub-scale).
disagreements.resolution: The spread is now only ~7%, and agent_2 is the remaining high outlier, resting on 32x with no rate update. A 31x multiple on ~$13.4 2028E EPS, less ~$5 for litigation, gives ~$410; a DCF at an ~8.75% WACC gives ~$380. I reconcile at ~$405, essentially the agent mean.

disagreements.positions: Agent_2 has dropped the 'Hugo clearance this fall' claim. Others treat it as undated headline risk.
disagreements.resolution: Confirmed. The only September Hugo clearance was the LigaSure RAS Maryland instrument (2026-09-16). The general-surgery and gyn 510(k)s filed on 2026-06-03 are still pending.

one_month_reasoning: The only dated event is the Q3 print after the close on 2026-10-20 (confirmed by multiple previews), bringing the first EUP 2.0 quantification against a ~19% Q3 2025 procedure comp, offset by four straight beats. All five agents converge on a ~$400 median with ~11-12% one-month sigma, and I see no checked reason to move off their mean.
confidence_reason: In round 2 the forecasts converged tightly (P(>=401) 0.49-0.55; fair values $396-425). My checks confirmed the inputs they already use (5.29% 10-year, EUP scope, Hugo status, Oct 20 date) and corrected only a stale round-1 supervisor figure, so nothing justifies replacing the mean.
thesis_break_reason: Four of five agents hold $300, about 22x 2028E EPS and ~9% below the $328.57 July 2026 low. A rates-only de-rating to 25-26x would stop near $335-345. A close at $300 would most likely mean fundamental damage: a 2027 procedure guide below ~11%, an EUP drag well beyond 3% of I&A/procedure, an adverse turn in the hospital class case (trial 2027-09-14), or visible share loss to Ottava or Hugo.
key_drivers: EUP 2.0 sizing on the 2026-10-20 call. The program covers a subset of instruments for high-volume benign procedures and excludes stapling, energy and force feedback; the plausible 2027 range is a 1-3% I&A/procedure drag (the 2020 program netted ~-1% over 2019-21 in the 10-K data).

US procedure growth (12% in Q2) against the ACA attrition in HCA's Q2 10-Q (uninsured admissions +23.4%, exchange admissions -15%, outpatient surgeries -3.4%), with Medicaid work requirements from 2027-01-01; the 2027 guide comes in January.
Rates: the 10-year rose from 4.79% to 5.29% in September 2026 (FRED) after the 2026-09-16 Fed hike, capping the multiple near 30.5-31.5x NTM.
Litigation: the Ninth Circuit SIS reversal (2026-08-13) and the hospital class trial on 2027-09-14, inside the horizon; a ~$5/share expected-value haircut and a fatter left tail.
Competition: Ottava (De Novo 2026-07-22, limited launch) and Hugo (general-surgery 510(k)s pending) weigh on the multiple more than on 2027 EPS.

fair_value.reason: 2028E non-GAAP EPS of ~$13.4 (FY27 consensus $12.09 less ~1.5-2% for the EUP and coverage, grown ~13%) x ~31x NTM with the 10-year at 5.29% gives ~$415, less a ~$5/share litigation haircut, gives ~$410. Cross-checked against a DCF at an ~8.75% WACC (~$380), the reconciled value is ~$405 on ~355M diluted shares. This is down from round 1's $420 because the 10-year is ~30bp higher than round 1 used.

summary: In round 2 the five forecasts converged tightly: P(close >= $401 on 2027-10-01) is 0.49-0.55 (mean 0.51), fair values are $396-425 (mean ~$406), and four of five set the thesis break at $300. My checks confirmed the inputs they now share: the 10-year at 5.29% on Sep 30 (FRED, correcting round 1's stale ~5.0%), an EUP 2.0 limited to a subset of benign-procedure instruments, Hugo general-surgery clearance still pending, and the Q3 print on Oct 20. I found nothing that justifies moving off the mean ladder, so confidence is low and the mean should stand. The Oct 20 EUP quantification and the January 2027 procedure guide are the binaries that will move this name.
